test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Hasten
solution: The correct answer is “**Dawdle**”. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ ** __ • "**Hasten**" means to be quick to do something or to cause something to happen more quickly. (किसी काम को जल्दी से करना) • **Example**- We need to hasten our efforts if we want to meet the deadline. • "**Dawdle**" means to waste time; be slow. (समय बर्बाद करना; धीमा होना) • **Example**- He tended to dawdle in the mornings, making him late for work. • Hence, the option that is Opposite in meaning to the given word is 'Dawdle’. Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 4**’. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** • Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options. • **Triumph**: a great victory or achievement. (एक महान विजय या उपलब्धि) • **Spooky**: sinister or ghostly in a way that causes fear and unease. (एक तरह से डरावना या भूतिया जो भय और बेचैनी का कारण बनता है) • **Present**: in a particular place. (एक विशेष स्थान पर) 40:Ta31, The correct answer is “**disrupt**”.
